description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for the 'Administrator' class within the Thunder namespace, including nested classes and related components for managing proxies, stubs, message dispatching, and IPC server functionality. It appears to be part of a larger IPC or COM-like framework, handling proxy/stub registration, reference counting, and message dispatching.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages IPC proxies, stubs, message dispatching, and resource management within the Thunder framework. Implements singleton pattern, registration, and lookup of interfaces, and handles reference counting and cleanup.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job that encapsulates an IPC message and channel, providing methods for setting, clearing, and invoking the message.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations, providing methods to submit and revoke jobs.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: An implementation of IIPCServer that manages a thread pool to process IPC jobs asynchronously.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Administrator.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers interface proxies and stubs for a given interface type.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters interface proxies and stubs for a given interface type.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface proxy with the IPC channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface proxy from the IPC channel.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes a communication channel and handles associated proxies.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a proxy object or releases a proxy.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Dispatches an IPC message to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the thread pool for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revoke a previously submitted job from the thread pool.
